To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

weed management practices significantly reduced weed density (18-8m), weed biomass (12-7g m) as well as enhanced the grain yield (3208-5kg ha) of wheat crop under rainfed conditions of Chakwal, Pakistan.

the incorporation of sorghums and sesbania green manuring in summer followed by herbicides application in wheat crop under rain fed conditions significantly reduced the weed population and increased grain yield.

the integrated weed management practices followed by the incorporation of green manure crop in summer significantly suppressed the weed density, biomass and enhanced the weed control efficiency and grain yield of the wheat crop under rain fed conditions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the integrated weed management strategies followed by green manuring crop in wheat under rain fed condition.
the evaluation of different integrated weed control strategies followed by green manure practices in wheat under rain fed environment of the Punjab.
the evaluation of the integrated weed control practices followed by summer green management on weeds and grain yields of rain fed wheat under subtropical conditions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the integrated weed management strategies followed by green manuring practices in wheat crop under rain fed conditions were found to be effective and economical in reducing weed population and increasing grain yields of wheat.
the integrated weed management strategies in combination with green manure practices can significantly reduce the weed density and weed biomass and increase the grain yield of wheat.

the application of buctril super (750ml ha) followed by incorporation of sorgham green manure in summer is the most suitable and economical strategy for the effective management of weeds in wheat crop.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the incorporation of sorghums green manure in the summer followed by buctril super application at 750ml ha in the wheat crop resulted in maximum wheat yield of 320.85kg ha.
the integrated weed control strategies followed by the green manure crop of sorghum in summer can significantly reduce weed density, biomass and increase the wheat grain yield.
incorporation of green manuring crops in summer followed by herbicides application in wheat crop is an effective strategy in weed management under rain fed conditions.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the incorporation of sorghums as green manure crop in the summer and the application of herbicides in wheat crop can be used as an efficient integrated weed management strategy in wheat crop under rain fed conditions in order to achieve maximum yield and weed control efficiency.

the incorporation of sorgham green manuring in summer followed by application of buctril super in winter is an effective integrated weed management strategy for the control of weeds and to improve grain yield in wheat under rain fed areas of the sub tropical regions.
the integrated management of weeds with green manuring crop in summer followed by application of herbicides is an effective strategy for weed control and grain yield improvement in wheat.
